data: Which line in the right figure represents the smallest nonzero value for k (objective shifting rate)?

The question asks which line in the right figure represents the smallest nonzero value for k (objective shifting rate). From the caption, we know that the lines correspond to different values of k, ranging from 0 to 1. The smallest nonzero value for k is 1e-4. Therefore, the line representing this value should be the one closest to the blue line labeled 'k = 0' but not overlapping with it. In the right figure, the line corresponding to k = 1e-4 is the orange line.
